original:
द्रोणस्तु सेनापतिरभवत् कौरवाणां महाबलः ।
चक्रव्यूहं रचयित्वा योध्यमानान् न्यवारयत् ॥
sanskrit:
द्रोणस्तु सेनापतिरभवत् कौरवाणां महाबलः ।
चक्रव्यूहं रचयित्वा योध्यमानान् न्यवारयत् ॥
transliteration:
droṇas tu senāpatir abhavat kauravāṇāṃ mahābalaḥ |
cakravyūhaṃ racayitvā yodhyamānān nyavārayat ||
translation: Mighty Dronacharya became commander-in-chief of the Kauravas and formed the formidable Chakravyuha formation in the fierce war.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: महाबली द्रोणाचार्य कौरवों के सेनापति बने और उन्होंने अजेय चक्रव्यूह की रचना कर भीषण युद्ध का संचालन किया।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: महाबली द्रोणाचार्य कौरवांचे सेनापती झाले आणि त्यांनी अजिंक्य चक्रव्यूह रचून घनघोर युद्धाचे नेतृत्व केले.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: Drona Parva narrates the five intense days of warfare including the heroic sacrifice of Abhimanyu and the fall of Jayadratha.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: Features complex military strategic formations and the ethical dilemmas confronting Drona.
